content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Managing Director position at the International Monetary Fund. Tell about your experience in global economic policy, currency crisis management, and developing countries' economic programs. Describe your vision for reforming the IMF and its role in promoting sustainable economic growth. Also reflect on how you would address the economic impacts of climate change. Length about 450 words.
